$comment: Scripts are Node tooling, not an Expo render target. Vite 8/Oxc selects the nearest tsconfig while loading these source-only proof tests; inheriting the app's extensionless expo/tsconfig.base fails before both the new proof test and unchanged native-config.test.ts collect. Reuse the existing tools Node semantics rather than change the app config, install another dependency tree or stub a native target. The root tsconfig.tools.json remains the production script type gate.
